cases.name: the entry count stops bounding anything
caught_by: the count bounds what is shown: 2, wanted 1
and bounds the edges with it: ['2026-01-01-older.md', '2026-02-02-newer.md'], wanted ['2026-02-02-newer.md']

cases.name: a claim is printed whole, however long
caught_by: a claim is cut at its first sentence: 'The first sentence stops here. And then a great deal more. And then a great deal more. And then a great deal more. And then a great deal more. And then a great deal more. And then a great deal more. And then a great deal more. And then a great deal more. And then a great deal more. And then a great deal more. And then a great deal more. And then a great deal more. And then a great deal more.', wanted 'The first sentence stops here.'
a claim with no sentence break is cut to the limit: 500, wanted 140

cases.name: entries come back oldest first
caught_by: entries come back newest first: ['2026-01-01-older.md', '2026-02-02-newer.md'], wanted ['2026-02-02-newer.md', '2026-01-01-older.md']
an entry's kind is read: 'process', wanted 'fix'
the span is the oldest and newest shown: '2026-02-02 to 2026-01-01', wanted '2026-01-01 to 2026-02-02'
and bounds the edges with it: ['2026-01-01-older.md'], wanted ['2026-02-02-newer.md']

cases.name: a caveat loses the verdict recorded against it
caught_by: each entry's caveat is found, with its verdict: [('A newer edge.', 'untriaged'), ('An older edge.', 'untriaged')], wanted [('A newer edge.', 'deliberate'), ('An older edge.', 'deliberate')]

cases.name: commits since the tag are counted from the tag instead of to it
cases.old: since_tag = git("rev-list", "--count", f"{tag}..HEAD") if tag else ""
cases.new: since_tag = git("rev-list", "--count", f"HEAD..{tag}") if tag else ""
caught_by: commits since the tag are counted: 0, wanted 1
